description.value: Structural MRI voxel-based morphometry and ROI analyses compared grey matter volumes among healthy controls, adults with ADHD, and adults with ADHD and comorbid cocaine dependence.

spans.text: We compared regional grey matter volumes of 10 non-medicated male ADHD patients with comorbid cocaine dependence, 14 non-medicated male ADHD patients without cocaine dependence and 15 healthy control participants matched for age and premorbid intellectual functioning, using voxel-based morphometry (VBM) using both a whole-brain analysis and a priori ROI analysis

description.value: VBM preprocessing of structural T1 images including segmentation, DARTEL registration, resampling, modulation, normalization to MNI space, and smoothing.

spans.text: Pre-processing for VBM included segmenting structural T1 images into grey matter, white matter, cerebrospinal fluid, and skull using the standard segmentation tool of SPM8.
Images were then processed and analyzed with SPM8 ( http://www.fil.ion.ucl.ac.uk/spm/software/ ) implemented in Matlab 7.5.0 (The Mathworks Inc., Natick, MA).
Subsequently, images were resampled to 1.5 mm × 1.5 mm × 1.5 mm voxels, modulated and normalized to MNI space and smoothed with a standard 8 mm FWHM Gaussian kernel.
